select a.calculate_date_year, a.calculate_date_month, a.profit_current as profitCurrent, a.profit_total as profit_total, b.bonus_current as bonus_current, b.payment_current as payment_current, c.bonus_current as bonus_current_deputy, c.payment_current as payment_current_deputy from (SELECT a.calculate_date_year, a.calculate_date_month, sum(a.profit_current) as profit_current, sum(a.profit_total) as profit_total FROM kpi_proj_guess_base_info a
group by a.calculate_date_year, a.calculate_date_month) a,
(SELECT a.divide_year, a.divide_month, sum(a.bonus_current) as bonus_current, sum(a.payment_current) as payment_current FROM kpi_proj_guess_divide a where a.divide_type = 'PROJECT_SPONSOR' group by a.divide_year, a.divide_month) b,
(SELECT a.divide_year, a.divide_month, sum(a.bonus_current) as bonus_current, sum(a.payment_current) as payment_current FROM kpi_proj_guess_divide a where a.divide_type = 'PROJECT_COSPONSOR' group by a.divide_year, a.divide_month) c where a.calculate_date_year = b.divide_year and a.calculate_date_month = b.divide_month and a.calculate_date_year = c.divide_year and a.calculate_date_month = c.divide_month and a.calculate_date_year = #{param.calculateDateYear} and a.calculate_date_month = #{param.calculateDateMonth} order by calculate_date_year desc, calculate_date_month desc

select a.calculate_date_year divide_year, a.calculate_date_month divide_month, a.profit_current as profitCurrent, a.profit_total as profit_total, c.bonus_current as bonus_Current, c.payment_current as payment_current, b.bonus_current as bonusCurrentAdd, b.payment_current as paymentCurrentAdd,
d.bonus_current as bonusCurrentDeputy, d.payment_current as paymentCurrentDeputy, e.bonus_current as bonusCurrentDeputyAdd, e.payment_current as paymentCurrentDeputyAdd from (SELECT a.calculate_date_year, a.calculate_date_month, sum(a.profit_current) as profit_current, sum(a.profit_total) as profit_total FROM kpi_proj_guess_base_info a
group by a.calculate_date_year, a.calculate_date_month) a left join (SELECT a.divide_year, a.divide_month, a.kpi_proj_guess_id, sum(a.bonus_current) as bonus_current, sum(a.payment_current) as payment_current, b.id, b.proj_source FROM kpi_proj_guess_divide a inner join kpi_proj_guess_base_info b on a.kpi_proj_guess_id = b.id where a.divide_type = 'PROJECT_SPONSOR' and b.proj_source = 'NEW' group by a.divide_year, a.divide_month, a.kpi_proj_guess_id) b on a.calculate_date_year = b.divide_year and a.calculate_date_month = b.divide_month left join (SELECT a.divide_year, a.divide_month, a.kpi_proj_guess_id, sum(a.bonus_current) as bonus_current, sum(a.payment_current) as payment_current, b.id, b.proj_source FROM kpi_proj_guess_divide a inner join kpi_proj_guess_base_info b on a.kpi_proj_guess_id = b.id where a.divide_type = 'PROJECT_SPONSOR' and b.proj_source = 'HISTORY' group by a.divide_year, a.divide_month, a.kpi_proj_guess_id) c on a.calculate_date_year = c.divide_year and a.calculate_date_month = c.divide_month left join (SELECT a.divide_year, a.divide_month, a.kpi_proj_guess_id, sum(a.bonus_current) as bonus_current, sum(a.payment_current) as payment_current, b.id, b.proj_source FROM kpi_proj_guess_divide a inner join kpi_proj_guess_base_info b on a.kpi_proj_guess_id = b.id where a.divide_type = 'PROJECT_COSPONSOR' and b.proj_source = 'NEW' group by a.divide_year, a.divide_month, a.kpi_proj_guess_id) d on a.calculate_date_year = d.divide_year and a.calculate_date_month = d.divide_month left join (SELECT a.divide_year, a.divide_month, a.kpi_proj_guess_id, sum(a.bonus_current) as bonus_current, sum(a.payment_current) as payment_current, b.id, b.proj_source FROM kpi_proj_guess_divide a inner join kpi_proj_guess_base_info b on a.kpi_proj_guess_id = b.id where a.divide_type = 'PROJECT_COSPONSOR' and b.proj_source = 'HISTORY' group by a.divide_year, a.divide_month, a.kpi_proj_guess_id) e on a.calculate_date_year = e.divide_year and a.calculate_date_month = e.divide_month group by a.calculate_date_year, a.calculate_date_month order by a.calculate_date_year desc, a.calculate_date_month desc
